items.title: Emile Barnes Interview, 1962-01-03
items.q: So between Tony and Mr. LaVar, they straightened out. You know, between them, that would work that way.

ctx.x: Well, to tell you from 100% up, Louis. That's what the man Louis, he was good. He was interested. We had a wife, but he was good, or was good too. Tony Gardenas. You heard him play? Tony Gardenas was a good father to play. And pretty much on the heart of Louis. He was a good player and I liked him. Yeah. Pretty much on the heart of Louis.
And I don't say better or nothing, because I liked him. Mm-hm.
